years.title: Academic years & terms
years.subtitle: The years and terms everything else is recorded in — attendance, marks, fees and timetables.
years.note: One year is current: screens open on it. Set up next year’s classes in advance by adding the year now and making it current when it begins.
years.name: Name
years.noTerms: No terms — the year is one block. Add terms to split exams and reports.
years.closedHint: A closed year stays readable, but nothing new can be entered in it.

makeCurrentConfirm.title: Make {{name}} the current year?
makeCurrentConfirm.message: Every screen opens on the current year: attendance, marks, fees and timetables move to it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.message: Only a year with no sections can be deleted. This can’t be undone.

years.emptyHint: Add the current year to start setting up classes.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.subtitle: Every subject taught. Put them on classes in Classes & sections, then choose teachers in Teacher allocation.
subjects.subject: Subject
subjects.name: Name
subjects.emptyHint: Add them one by one, import a file, or use Quick setup in Classes & sections.

grading.title: Grading schemes
grading.subtitle: How a percentage turns into a grade on report cards. Classes use the default unless they pick another.
grading.name: Name

classes.title: Classes & sections
classes.subtitle: Classes, their sections for each year and campus, the subjects taught and the class teachers.
classes.name: Name
classes.subjectsHint: Tick the subjects taught in this class. Mark electives and second languages as optional.
classes.noSubjects: No subjects yet — add them in Subjects.
classes.noneOnClass: No subjects on this class yet.
classes.emptyHint: Quick setup adds a standard set of classes, sections and subjects in one go — you can change everything afterwards.

sections.title: Sections
sections.name: Section
sections.deleteMessage: Only a section with no students can be deleted; its teacher allocations go with it.

quickSetup.title: Quick setup
quickSetup.intro: Adds a standard set of classes with their sections for {{year}}. Existing classes and sections are kept.
quickSetup.sectionsHint: Add more sections to a class later
quickSetup.addSubjectsHint: English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, EVS, Computer Science, PE, Art and Music — put on each class.
quickSetup.safe: Safe to run again: it only adds what is missing.

allocation.title: Teacher allocation
allocation.subtitle: Who teaches each subject in each section, and the class teacher of each section. A change saves at once.
allocation.subject: Subject
allocation.closedYear: {{year}} is closed: allocations can be read but not changed.
allocation.noSubjects: {{name}} has no subjects yet. Add them in Classes & sections.
allocation.noClassesHint: Set up classes in Classes & sections first.
allocation.scopeNote: A teacher’s sections here (and the sections they are class teacher of) are their “My classes” for attendance, homework and marks.
